source_snapshot.procedure_direct_xlsx: 【Before Test】 1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition. 2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.). 【During Test】 1. Enter BMC-Web -> Operations -> Reboot BMC. 2. Click "Reboot BMC". 3. During BMC reboot, BMC-IP should disconnected. 4. After BMC reboot, BMC-IP should become connected, and BMC functions should be workable. 【After Test】 1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders. 2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.

test_case.test_name: Operations - Reboot BMC — parameterized review-layer procedure
test_case.purpose: Verify the exact BMC Web Operations/Reboot BMC control causes one management-controller reboot, a bounded management outage and complete recovery without changing host power state.
required_package: BMC firmware/WebUI/browser and exact target identity
Whether source WebUI action is mandatory or IPMI/Redfish is formally equivalent
Expected disconnect, network, daemon and full-function readiness timeouts
Critical-task exclusion, alternate console/recovery and post-reset function checklist
test_case.test_command: After confirming no flash/update/critical session is active and recording host/BMC baseline, use the approved browser to activate the exact WebUI Reboot BMC control once; capture the confirmation and visual timeline, independently poll network, TLS, authentication, Redfish, IPMI and WebUI readiness, then run the signed post-reboot function checklist.
test_case.expected_result: The BMC becomes unavailable within the configured onset window, returns within the recovery deadline, accepts fresh authenticated sessions on all required services, passes the function checklist, and leaves host power/workload state invariant.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires real WebUI evidence, observed outage and full service/function recovery within approved timeouts with unchanged host state. A substitute CLI reset, no observed transition, premature ping-only readiness, critical task interruption or missing function is FAIL/BLOCKED.
safety_gate: Confirm no update/recovery/critical BMC task is active
Use an independent recovery/observation path and one reset only
Bound each readiness phase and preserve host/workload state
Stop on timeout, identity change, repeated flapping or host impact; never auto-retry
expected_evidence: BMC/WebUI target identity, approval and no-critical-task baseline
Exact Operations-page action or approved equivalence record
Post-reset identity/functions/sensors/SEL and host power/workload invariance
Alternate recovery status and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On timeout do not issue repeated resets; preserve console/network traces, use the approved independent service-console or power-domain recovery once, and escalate before any host power action.
